request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Annual maintenance and enhancement funding for MLabs Core Tool Maintenance & Enhancement: Plutarch and Ply.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance and 33,866 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts via controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as helping serialize Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs states that a recent internal audit counted at least 26 teams building with Plutarch and Ply in the motivation section, while the rationale section says at least 15 teams were counted.
The proposal says Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in MLabs' public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.

The planned work prioritizes critical breakages and vulnerabilities first, then protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, then bug fixes, correctness improvements, optimizations, and developer-experience work.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved process.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

The proposal discloses prior MLabs funding from Project Catalyst, Intersect, and previous treasury governance actions, including prior Plutarch/Ply Catalyst funding and 70,000 ada from Intersect for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

The proposal says funds will be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified addresses, admin and leadership roles, an external Oversight Committee, reporting obligations, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document describes a 1,162,746 ada treasury withdrawal for annual Plutarch and Ply maintenance, submitted by Intersect on behalf of MLabs, with technical maintenance priorities, budget-process references, NCL claims, prior funding disclosures, and smart-contract oversight details, but it contains an inconsistent adoption count and does not state a completion deadline.
